'''A [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]''' was the [[Brother/Legends|brother]] of [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was a member of [[Clan Vizla]].<ref name="JoMGD" /><ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3664 BBY]], Shae and her brother were tasked with [[Mandalorian attack on a Republic envoy|assaulting]] a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]]. During the course of the attack, he was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aurei Eadon]].<ref name="JoMGD" />
